title: zamia humilis
intro: Zamia humilis, commonly known as Coontie, is a plant species native to the southeastern United States and the Caribbean. This plant is known for its edible rhizomes, which have been used as a food source for centuries. The health benefits of Zamia humilis include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The bioactive constituents of Zamia humilis include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects.
